channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, UK, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: BRAID Creative Commissions 2027: A Promise in Return (Responsible AI, GBP 8,000-12,000, Edinburgh Art Festival)
item.description: BRAID (Bridging Responsible AI Divides), University of Edinburgh, with Inspace, the Institute for Design Informatics and the Edinburgh Futures Institute · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Around seven commissions with budgets of GBP 8,000 to 12,000 each, inclusive of VAT and all costs. No application fee.

item.title: Arts Council England: National Lottery Project Grants (rolling)
item.description: Arts Council England · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 1,000 to GBP 100,000 per project. Decisions in about 8 weeks for requests up to GBP 30,000, about 12 weeks above that. No application fee.

item.title: Creative Scotland: Open Fund for Individuals (rolling)
item.description: Creative Scotland · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 500 to GBP 50,000 (two levels: up to GBP 20,000 with decisions in 10 weeks, GBP 20,001 to 50,000 in 14 weeks). National Lottery funded. No application fee.

item.title: UK Games Fund: Content Fund (rolling expressions of interest)
item.description: UK Games Fund (UK Games Talent and Finance CIC, backed by DCMS) · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 100,000 to 250,000 per project as a non-repayable grant for commercial games-for-entertainment content. Paid 70/30: the final 30 percent is released once third-party leverage funding is secured within the same financial year. No application fee.

item.title: The Elephant Trust: Autumn 2026 Grant Round (UK)
item.description: The Elephant Trust · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · Grants to visual artists of up to GBP 5,000; typical awards range GBP 2,000 to GBP 5,000. Projects with a total budget exceeding GBP 30,000 are not supported. No application fee.
